As an Assistant Purser, you will play a vital role in supporting either the Guest Services or Administration function onboard, depending on operational needs. This position is key to ensuring smooth guest operations, accurate documentation, and exceptional service delivery. You will supervise and support Guest Services Officers or coordinate administrative processes related to guest movement, compliance, and reporting, while upholding Princess Cruises’ standards of excellence, safety, and integrity.

Please note: Assignment to either the Guest Services or Administration function will be determined based on operational requirements and may remain fixed for the duration of the contract.

Guest Services Function
  • Supervise Guest Services Officers, ensuring they understand and adhere to all Hotel Policies & Procedures, financial controls, and service standards.
  • Provide ongoing coaching and support to help team members effectively use hotel systems and tools.
  • Ensure Guest Services Officers demonstrate commitment to the CRUISE program and Core Values in every interaction.
  • Assist the Guest Services Manager in scheduling staff to optimize coverage and maintain service standards.
  • Ensure guest complaints and hotel defects are documented accurately and escalated appropriately.
  • Support the resolution of lost luggage reports and ensure timely updates are provided to affected guests.
  • Promote ownership of guest issues among team members, ensuring follow-up and resolution are clearly communicated.

data.key_responsibilities:
As an Assistant Purser, you will play a vital role in supporting either the Guest Services or Administration function onboard, depending on operational needs. This position is key to ensuring smooth guest operations, accurate documentation, and exceptional service delivery. You will supervise and support Guest Services Officers or coordinate administrative processes related to guest movement, compliance, and reporting, while upholding Princess Cruises’ standards of excellence, safety, and integrity.

Please note: Assignment to either the Guest Services or Administration function will be determined based on operational requirements and may remain fixed for the duration of the contract.

Guest Services Function
  • Supervise Guest Services Officers, ensuring they understand and adhere to all Hotel Policies & Procedures, financial controls, and service standards.
  • Provide ongoing coaching and support to help team members effectively use hotel systems and tools.
  • Ensure Guest Services Officers demonstrate commitment to the CRUISE program and Core Values in every interaction.
  • Assist the Guest Services Manager in scheduling staff to optimize coverage and maintain service standards.
  • Ensure guest complaints and hotel defects are documented accurately and escalated appropriately.
  • Support the resolution of lost luggage reports and ensure timely updates are provided to affected guests.
  • Promote ownership of guest issues among team members, ensuring follow-up and resolution are clearly communicated.
  • Assist in delivering service and product knowledge training to Guest Services Officers.
  • Help develop routines that provide team members with experience across various service roles.
  • Maintain current knowledge of public health standards and assist in coordinating onboard responses to outbreak situations.Ensure Guest Services Officers maintain accurate floats and settle shipboard accounts correctly, in line with company procedures.
  • Monitor compliance with financial controls and support the resolution of discrepancies.

Administration Function
  • Work closely with port officials to provide suitable working areas and ensure accurate handover of guest documentation.
  • Prepare, process, and transmit APIS and Landing Order files to CBP, U.S. Coast Guard, and other authorities in compliance with MSPM and HESS-MS policies.
  • Advise onboard and shore-side teams on guest and crew counts prior to sailing, including international guest details requiring translated materials.
  • Ensure data integrity and confidentiality of Personally Identifiable Information (PII) at all times.
  • Accurately prepare and deliver the non-revenue list, Fleet Cabin utilization report, and coordinate disembarkation logistics.
  • Liaise with department managers and the Crew Manager to ensure non-revenue guests meet Customs and Immigration requirements.
  • Coordinate transfers with Port Agents and ensure proper documentation for guests breaking voyage or joining at Wayports.
  • Meet with shoreside embarkation teams prior to embarkation to provide documentation guidance and reference materials.
  • Ensure missing guest information is entered into the Navigator check-in app and required documentation is collected.
  • Be present in the terminal during embarkation and disembarkation to assist ground handlers and check-in supervisors.

Asst Purser may be assigned to Night Manager role and work during night shifts, managing overnight Hotel operations to ensure excellent guest service continues at all times.

data.key_responsibilities:
The Corporate Chief Baker serves as the operational extension of the Princess Cruises corporate office, with a primary focus on bakery and culinary excellence across the fleet. This role ensures the consistent execution, quality, safety, and profitability of bakery and assigned culinary operations in alignment with corporate standards, budgets, and regulatory requirements.
  • The Corporate Chief Baker plays a critical leadership role in driving guest satisfaction, food quality, crew development, and compliance, while championing Princess Cruises’ Core Values.
  • Ensure all assigned vessels fully comply with Company policies, USPH regulations, safety, environmental standards, and industry best practices.
  • Train shipboard bakery and galley teams on updated USPH requirements, equipment manuals, food safety procedures, and production standards.
  • Oversee proper use, care, and maintenance of bakery and galley equipment to maximize safety, efficiency, and equipment lifespan.
  • Partner with onboard F&B leadership and Technical teams to evaluate equipment condition and maintenance needs.
  • Ensure 100% compliance with Company recipes, execution methods, and presentation standards through tastings, supervision, and mise en place controls.
  • Monitor and control food costs, portioning, waste reduction, and product utilization to achieve assigned budget targets.
  • Verify that all food products received onboard meet purchasing specifications and ensure discrepancies are reported per company procedures.
  • Support OBR‑generating outlets to operate at profitable levels while maintaining brand standards.
  • Lead and support Executive Chefs and senior bakery leadership in performance management, appraisals, discipline, and ILO compliance.
  • Conduct formal training for bakery and galley positions in support of fleet succession planning.
  • Review shipboard performance appraisals and partner with onboard leadership to identify training and development needs.
  • Actively coach, mentor, and develop high‑potential team members across assigned ships and regions.
  • Maintain a professional and effective link between guests (while onboard), shipboard teams, and the corporate F&B office.
  • Champion Princess Cruises’ Core Values and C.R.U.I.S.E. philosophy through daily leadership behaviors.
  • Anticipate guest needs, resolve food‑related concerns promptly, and support improvements in guest satisfaction scores.
  • Contribute to the development of new concepts, recipes, and initiatives that enhance guest experience and revenue.
  • Provide detailed post‑visit reports and formal summaries following each ship visit.
  • Deliver monthly regional and ship‑by‑ship performance summaries, including operational results, challenges, and improvement plans.
  • Maintain ongoing communication with assigned ships and shoreside leadership outside of ship visits to ensure alignment and consistency.
data.skills_knowledge_expertise:
As a Princess Leader, the Corporate Chief Baker is expected to:
  • Inspire Passionate Teams by fostering an inclusive, respectful, and high‑performance culture.
  • Deliver Operational Excellence through clear goals, accountability, and data‑driven decision‑making.
  • Champion Personalized Service by empowering teams to consistently deliver memorable guest experiences.
  • Extensive senior‑level bakery and culinary leadership experience within cruise, hospitality, or large‑scale food operations.
  • Strong knowledge of USPH regulations, food safety, sanitation, and international maritime standards.
  • Proven ability to manage multi‑unit operations, budgets, and performance across diverse regions.
  • Demonstrated experience in training, coaching, and developing culinary leadership teams.
  • Excellent communication, reporting, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Willingness and ability to travel extensively and work onboard vessels globally.
data.title: Corporate Chief Baker

The Teppanyaki Chef is responsible for delivering an exceptional dining experience by preparing and serving authentic Teppanyaki cuisine in a theatrical, interactive setting onboard Sphere-class ships. This role requires a dynamic and skilled culinary professional with a passion for performance-based cooking, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to work under pressure in a high-volume, multicultural environment.

The Teppanyaki Chef plays a vital leadership role within the culinary team and is accountable for all aspects of Teppanyaki operations, including preparation, production, staff training, and food safety compliance. This position reports directly to the Executive Chef and works closely with other culinary leaders to ensure the highest standards of food quality and guest satisfaction.

Culinary Execution & Guest Experience:
  • Prepare and present Teppanyaki dishes in front of guests, combining culinary expertise with engaging performance techniques to create an entertaining and memorable dining experience.
  • Follow all standardized recipes and presentation guidelines to ensure consistency and quality across all dishes.
  • Maintain a professional and energetic presence while cooking live in front of guests.
Operational & Organizational Duties:
  • Ensure the galley and Teppanyaki cooking area are clean, organized, and operating in compliance with safety and sanitation standards at all times.
  • Collaborate with the Executive Chef to maintain accurate inventory levels and oversee daily requisitions to meet operational demands.
  • Monitor portion control, waste management, and production efficiency to stay within budget constraints related to labor, ingredients, and equipment use.
Quality Control & Compliance:
  • Conduct regular checks of food preparation and storage areas to ensure compliance with Princess Cruises’ culinary and safety standards.
  • Enforce adherence to USPH (United States Public Health) and HACCP protocols for food handling, hygiene, and sanitation.
  • Assist the Executive Chef in implementing improvements and corrective actions as needed

  • Ability to entertain and wow guests with performance cooking while explaining cooking process and applicable culinary history.
  • Advanced English verbal/writing skills.
  • Minimum 1 year of Teppanyaki cooking experience and minimum 2 years Asian-influence culinary experience.

As a Sr Assistant Purser, you will serve in a dual-capacity leadership role, supporting either Guest Services or Crew Office operations depending on the ship’s operational requirements. This position is critical to delivering exceptional service experiences for guests and ensuring the well-being, administrative support, and satisfaction of our onboard teammates. You will be entrusted with driving service excellence, operational efficiency, and team development while upholding Princess Cruises’ commitment to safety, inclusivity, and innovation.

Please note: Assignment to either the Guest Services or Crew Office function will be determined based on operational needs and may remain fixed for the duration of the contract.

Guest Services Operations
  • Inspire and lead a team of Guest Services professionals, fostering a culture of empathy, responsiveness, and excellence.
  • Provide coaching and mentorship to ensure consistent delivery of personalized and frictionless guest experiences.
  • Oversee the Guest Services Desk, CrewCall Chat, and Telephone Center, ensuring smooth, efficient, and professional operations.
  • Promote and integrate MedallionClass technology to enhance guest interactions and streamline service delivery.
  • Ensure all team members are trained and confident in using digital platforms to support guest needs.
  • Take ownership of resolving guest complaints and concerns with professionalism and urgency.
  • Collaborate with onboard departments to address complex issues and ensure high levels of guest satisfaction.
  • Maintain accuracy in guest folio management, onboard payments, and financial transactions.
  • Ensure compliance with financial policies and procedures, minimizing discrepancies and errors.
  • Partner with shipboard leaders to implement best practices and drive continuous improvement in service delivery.
  • Monitor KPIs and guest feedback to identify opportunities for operational enhancements.
  • Ensure all guest-facing operations comply with HESS policies, public health standards, and safety regulations.
  • Support emergency procedures and maintain readiness for audit and inspection requirements.
Crew Services Operations
  • Oversee all administrative services for crew members, including onboarding, offboarding, travel arrangements, and immigration documentation.
  • Ensure timely and accurate processing of pre-arrival, arrival, and departure paperwork in coordination with shore-side teams and authorities.
  • Manage crew berthing modules, optimizing space allocation and maintaining accuracy in crew management systems.
  • Ensure crew lists are updated in the ERP system and reflect real-time changes.
  • Monitor Crew Office performance, staffing levels, and adherence to service standards.
  • Lead regular team meetings and training sessions to ensure alignment with policies and procedures.
  • Ensure effective use of hotel systems to maintain accurate teammate records and operational data.
  • Provide empathetic support to crew members, addressing concerns and complaints with professionalism and care.
  • Promote the onboard CRUISE program, reinforcing shared values and fostering a positive work culture.
  • Deliver service and product knowledge training to Crew Office staff to enhance the overall teammate experience.
  • Set clear expectations and role descriptions for Crew Office team members.
  • Conduct fair and objective performance appraisals and support career development through coaching and training.
  • Ensure all team members complete required training and remain current on company policies and services.
  • Ensure full compliance with HESS MS, public health standards, and safety protocols.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and assist in emergency procedures, safeguarding crew records in accordance with company policy.
  • Address audit findings promptly and ensure corrective actions are implemented effectively.

  • Responsibly uses consumable items, staterooms supplies, linen, and cleaning chemicals avoiding unnecessary waste. 
  • Maintains assigned equipment clean and in good condition, avoiding misuse and unjustifiable wear and tear.
  • Embraces an inclusive and diverse culture, instills our Shared Purpose, Core Values and CRUISE service essentials. 
  • Shares best practices and efficiencies with the Rooms Division leadership team and colleagues. 
  • Embraces Company updates and strategies to deliver on our guest experience commitment.
  • Confidently performs General Emergency Procedure’s and duties with a sense of urgency as directed by HESS. 
  • Follows appropriate procedures for the correct handling and sorting of garbage, bio-hazardous and sharps waste as indicated in the Stateroom Steward Training Manual. 
  • Collaborate with persons in charge to create a safe and compliant environment while fostering a commitment to Operation Oceans Alive. 
  • Complies with company expectations and standards, including HESS policies. 
  • Maintains current, accurate knowledge of public health standards and ensures their ship is in continuous compliance with all hotel related public health policies.

• Audio Operations & Mixing
    Operate and mix live audio for a wide variety of performances including production shows, live bands, solo musicians, and guest entertainers. Ensure consistent, high-quality sound reinforcement across all venues, adapting to different performance styles and technical requirements.

  • System Management & Maintenance
    Oversee the daily operation, calibration, and maintenance of all onboard audio systems, including digital and analog consoles, wireless microphone systems, in-ear monitors, playback systems, and speaker arrays. Proactively identify and resolve technical issues to minimize downtime and ensure seamless show execution.

  • Show Preparation & Execution
    Collaborate with the Production Manager – Audio and Entertainment Technical team to prepare for each performance. This includes loading and programming show files, conducting sound checks, setting up microphones and monitors, and ensuring all audio cues are executed accurately during live shows.

  • Technical Collaboration
    Work closely with lighting, video, automation, and stage management teams to coordinate technical elements and ensure cohesive production values. Participate in production meetings and contribute to creative problem-solving and show enhancements.

  • Equipment Inventory & Documentation
    Maintain accurate records of all audio equipment, including inventory tracking, maintenance logs, and system configurations. Assist in managing spare parts and consumables to ensure readiness for repairs or replacements.

  • Training & Mentorship
    Support the development of junior audio technicians by providing hands-on training, guidance, and feedback. Foster a culture of safety, professionalism, and continuous improvement within the technical team.

  • Guest Experience & Quality Control
    Monitor and evaluate the audio quality of all performances from the audience perspective. Make real-time adjustments as needed to ensure an immersive and enjoyable experience for guests.

  • Compliance & Safety
    Adhere to all company policies, maritime regulations, and safety protocols. Ensure that all audio operations are conducted in a safe and compliant manner, including proper cable management, equipment handling, and emergency procedures.

As the subject matter expert for onboard Finance operations, this position serves as the central source of knowledge within the shipboard Finance department. It provides comprehensive training, support, and guidance to Finance personnel across all areas of responsibility, including shipboard property management systems, point-of-sale and inventory systems, financial processing, crew payroll administration, and related policies and procedures. The role ensures consistent application of administration and financial processes and acts as the first line of support and primary liaison between shipboard teams and the shoreside office, facilitating effective communication and operational alignment across the fleet.

Key responsibilities include:
  • Fleet Finance Oversight: Conduct regular ship visits to provide guidance, assessments, and inspections of onboard Finance operations.
  • Cross-Functional Communication: Serve as the primary liaison for Finance-related queries between shipboard and shoreside teams.
  • Compliance & Audit: Perform audits to ensure adherence to internal controls and accounting standards.
  • Talent Development: Support training, coaching, and development of shipboard Finance personnel.
  • Policy & Procedure Management: Assist in creating, updating, and implementing accounting policies and procedures.
  • Operational Efficiency: Identify and implement best practices and process improvements across the fleet.
  • Technology & Systems Enhancement: Collaborate on IT priorities and participate in testing system upgrades impacting Finance processes.
  • Financial Analysis: Conduct analyses to support decision-making and optimize operational performance.
  • Project Support: Provide expertise on specialized projects assigned by senior leadership.
  • Documentation: Develop and maintain reference materials to standardize Finance operations fleet-wide.
  • Emergency Coverage: Assume shipboard Finance roles during emergencies to ensure continuity.
  • Additional Duties: Perform other tasks as needed to support corporate and fleet Finance objectives.
data.skills_knowledge_expertise:

  • Strong understanding of onboard Finance department operations, including policies, procedures, and compliance standards.
  • Minimum of 5 years of proven experience in financial roles within cruise ship operations or equivalent corporate finance environment.
  • Highly motivated, proactive, and self-driven professional with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
  • Excellent command of English, both written and verbal, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally across all organizational levels.
  • Strong relationship-building capabilities and professional demeanor; able to collaborate effectively with shipboard and corporate teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to design training materials and deliver effective training sessions to diverse audiences.
  • Innovative and hands-on approach to planning and execution; capable of providing sound leadership and motivating teams toward company objectives.
  • Willingness and ability to travel extensively, both domestically and internationally, including weekends and holidays.

  • Encourage participation in activities and actively respond to guest needs. 
  • Work on select port days as assigned by the Youth Manager.
  • Assist the Youth Manager plan and prepare activity schedules for all age groups.

Note: This is a seasonal job opportunity and successful candidates will be expected to be on call and deployed seasonally based on projected guest counts. Employment assignments range from one to six weeks and are not always guaranteed.

• The Senior Photographer in the Photo Department is responsible for creating unique photo memories at sea, in alignment with the company's brand strategy and commitment to excellent customer service. 
  • The Senior Photographer is responsible for ensuring financial performance is met, which involves consistently achieving budgeted sales, image count, and sell-through targets for each voyage. Additionally, they are expected to explain products to passengers and use effective sales techniques. The senior photographer is responsible for ensuring customer satisfaction, creating a positive first impression for every passenger. They engage with passengers, observe their preferences, and make adjustments to the service as needed.
  • The Senior Photographer is responsible for executing marketing strategies, events, visual directives, and price changes in accordance with the relevant signage and advertising. They have a thorough understanding of the Princess product range and photo-video operations, ensure merchandise is restocked daily, and produce images that are correctly exposed, focused, and printed. They promptly communicate any issues regarding product quality or stock levels to the management team.
  • The Senior Photographer also participates in training and staff meetings, demonstrating leadership to the Photo-Video team, and participating in required Princess U courses. They ensure image count targets and quality are achieved at every photographic event, perform all Photo-Video inventories, organise and maintain secure stockrooms, lockers, and storage areas, take accountability for protecting issued equipment and Company assets, resolve technical issues, and demonstrate accurate knowledge of Photo Lab opening and closing procedures.
  • In accordance with operational requirements, the Senior Photographer may also be tasked with the role of Master Photographer (Premium Studio Photographer). This position entails responsibility for the PhotoStudio programme, a premium by-appointment photography programme on Princess Cruises luxury vessels. Their duties include portrait photography, conducting viewing and sales sessions, and selling photo images and packages. They work with the photo team to drive bookings and manage session scheduling. They use post-production software to enhance images and maintain a clean, well-organised studio. They also work with the on-board photo manager to achieve budgeted sales targets.

The Fleet Travelling, Broadcast & Media Producer is a fleet‑wide creative leader and technical subject‑matter expert responsible for delivering high‑quality media production across our ships. This role combines hands‑on content creation, technical broadcast operations, and fleet support, ensuring consistent brand excellence in all guest‑facing and crew‑facing video content.
You will capture, produce, and curate compelling storytelling that elevates the onboard experience while maintaining the operational reliability of broadcast systems, VOD networks, digital signage, and shipboard media infrastructure. This position also plays a key role in dry docks, newbuild installations, and broadcast equipment upgrades.
  • Capture, edit, and produce high‑quality video content featuring entertainment, activities, and guest programming.
  • Create and distribute updated video content aligned with new entertainment initiatives, working closely with the Senior Manager, Entertainment Broadcast & Media.
  • Produce ship‑specific TV content using approved corporate assets and design templates.
  • Develop fleet‑standard content using the Travelling Broadcast Production Kit, in partnership with onboard production teams.
  • Ensure all content meets brand guidelines, quality standards, and platform requirements.
  • Maintain consistent production value and broadcast standards across the fleet for both Guest and Teammate TV channels.
  • Oversee and audit xiCMS Video On‑Demand systems fleetwide, ensuring performance accuracy, content quality, and proper operation for guest and crew channels.
  • Review, upload, and update shipboard content, while coaching broadcast teams in effective VOD management.
  • Support and verify proper functioning of fleetwide BGM (Background Music) systems.
  • Collaborate with shipboard management to identify and resolve broadcast‑related operational challenges.
  • Maintain clear alignment and communication with head office regarding issues, system behavior, and fleet needs.
  • Partner with Theater teams to ensure proper operation and upkeep of all broadcast‑related equipment in alternative entertainment venues.
  • Provide on‑site support during dry docks and newbuilds for the installation, testing, and configuration of Broadcast Control Center equipment.
  • Act as the on‑site liaison between the Senior Manager and shipyard vendors/technical partners.
  • Manage and implement vendor‑supplied content for revenue areas and support partner teams in developing brand‑standard promotional content.
data.skills_knowledge_expertise:
• Proven subject‑matter expertise in broadcast operations, media production, and content creation.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and influence diverse technical and creative teams.
  • Strong strategic thinking with the ability to collaborate with internal and external partners on content‑related initiatives.
  • Excellent project management skills, with the ability to analyze production plans, schedules, and budgets.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to present complex technical concepts to non‑technical stakeholders.
  • Advanced skills in video production, editing, camera operation, lighting, and audio capture.
  • Working knowledge of VOD systems, video routing, digital signage networks, control room operations, and satellite distribution platforms.
  • Experience producing content in fast‑paced, travel‑intensive, or shipboard environments preferred.
  • Ability to work independently, travel extensively across the fleet, and quickly adapt to varying shipboard needs.

data.key_responsibilities:
As an Assistant Purser, you will play a vital role in supporting either the Guest Services or Administration function onboard, depending on operational needs. This position is key to ensuring smooth guest operations, accurate documentation, and exceptional service delivery. You will supervise and support Guest Services Officers or coordinate administrative processes related to guest movement, compliance, and reporting, while upholding Princess Cruises’ standards of excellence, safety, and integrity.

Please note: Assignment to either the Guest Services or Administration function will be determined based on operational requirements and may remain fixed for the duration of the contract.

Guest Services Function
  • Supervise Guest Services Officers, ensuring they understand and adhere to all Hotel Policies & Procedures, financial controls, and service standards.
  • Provide ongoing coaching and support to help team members effectively use hotel systems and tools.
  • Ensure Guest Services Officers demonstrate commitment to the CRUISE program and Core Values in every interaction.
  • Assist the Guest Services Manager in scheduling staff to optimize coverage and maintain service standards.
  • Ensure guest complaints and hotel defects are documented accurately and escalated appropriately.
  • Support the resolution of lost luggage reports and ensure timely updates are provided to affected guests.
  • Promote ownership of guest issues among team members, ensuring follow-up and resolution are clearly communicated.
  • Assist in delivering service and product knowledge training to Guest Services Officers.
  • Help develop routines that provide team members with experience across various service roles.
  • Maintain current knowledge of public health standards and assist in coordinating onboard responses to outbreak situations.Ensure Guest Services Officers maintain accurate floats and settle shipboard accounts correctly, in line with company procedures.
  • Monitor compliance with financial controls and support the resolution of discrepancies.

Administration Function
  • Work closely with port officials to provide suitable working areas and ensure accurate handover of guest documentation.
  • Prepare, process, and transmit APIS and Landing Order files to CBP, U.S. Coast Guard, and other authorities in compliance with MSPM and HESS-MS policies.
  • Advise onboard and shore-side teams on guest and crew counts prior to sailing, including international guest details requiring translated materials.
  • Ensure data integrity and confidentiality of Personally Identifiable Information (PII) at all times.
  • Accurately prepare and deliver the non-revenue list, Fleet Cabin utilization report, and coordinate disembarkation logistics.
  • Liaise with department managers and the Crew Manager to ensure non-revenue guests meet Customs and Immigration requirements.
  • Coordinate transfers with Port Agents and ensure proper documentation for guests breaking voyage or joining at Wayports.
  • Meet with shoreside embarkation teams prior to embarkation to provide documentation guidance and reference materials.
  • Ensure missing guest information is entered into the Navigator check-in app and required documentation is collected.
  • Be present in the terminal during embarkation and disembarkation to assist ground handlers and check-in supervisors.

Asst Purser may be assigned to Night Manager role and work during night shifts, managing overnight Hotel operations to ensure excellent guest service continues at all times.

Operational Support:

As Finance Manager aboard Princess Cruises, you will play a pivotal role in managing and overseeing all financial processes, from cash handling to reconciliation of transactions and auditing. This position ensures that all financial activities onboard adhere to Princess Cruises' policies and procedures, with a strong focus on accuracy, compliance, and guest satisfaction. You will lead a team of finance specialists and collaborate with other departments to drive operational efficiency and maintain the highest financial standards.

Financial Management & Compliance: 
  • Manage and oversee the ship’s cash account, payment of guest and teammate folios, and all receipt and payment vouchers in strict adherence to company policies and procedures. Prepare bank deposits, process pay-ins and payouts, and audit financial transactions for accuracy.
Guest & Crew Transactions: 
  • Oversee Guest and Crew ATMs, ensuring credit card settlements are completed accurately each voyage. Investigate any cash variances promptly and in accordance with standard procedures.
Auditing & Reconciliation: 
  • Conduct daily audits of financial systems, including Property Management System (PMS) and Point of Sale (POS) systems, to ensure proper balancing. 
  • Audit all business partner charges and track excessive charges and voids. Ensure the accurate balancing of group bookings, Weddings, and Celebration Packages.
Staff Training & Development: 
  • Lead regular training sessions for the finance team on cash handling policies, financial systems, and internal controls. 
  • Provide coaching, performance feedback, and development opportunities to ensure the team operates at peak efficiency.
Guest Service Excellence: 
  • Ensure every guest interaction reflects the highest standards of hospitality and financial accuracy. Take ownership of any guest financial issues and resolve them in accordance with company policies, leaving a lasting positive impression.
Cash Management: 
  • Oversee the daily balancing of cash and credit card transactions. Ensure the integrity of financial records, monitor prepaid gifts and services, and reconcile house accounts. Manage cash orders and ensure proper documentation of cash flow.
Financial Reporting & Monitoring: 
  • Verify and audit exception reports, ensuring compliance with MSPM financial policies. Maintain accurate records of tax applications, VAT reporting, and other financial data.
Collaboration & Communication: 
  • Maintain open communication with onboard management, the Guest Services Manager, and shoreside teams. 
  • Provide valuable feedback to improve the guest experience and onboard operations.

As a Sr Assistant Purser, you will serve in a dual-capacity leadership role, supporting either Guest Services or Crew Office operations depending on the ship’s operational requirements. This position is critical to delivering exceptional service experiences for guests and ensuring the well-being, administrative support, and satisfaction of our onboard teammates. You will be entrusted with driving service excellence, operational efficiency, and team development while upholding Princess Cruises’ commitment to safety, inclusivity, and innovation.

Please note: Assignment to either the Guest Services or Crew Office function will be determined based on operational needs and may remain fixed for the duration of the contract.

Guest Services Operations
  • Inspire and lead a team of Guest Services professionals, fostering a culture of empathy, responsiveness, and excellence.
  • Provide coaching and mentorship to ensure consistent delivery of personalized and frictionless guest experiences.
  • Oversee the Guest Services Desk, CrewCall Chat, and Telephone Center, ensuring smooth, efficient, and professional operations.
  • Promote and integrate MedallionClass technology to enhance guest interactions and streamline service delivery.
  • Ensure all team members are trained and confident in using digital platforms to support guest needs.
  • Take ownership of resolving guest complaints and concerns with professionalism and urgency.
  • Collaborate with onboard departments to address complex issues and ensure high levels of guest satisfaction.
  • Maintain accuracy in guest folio management, onboard payments, and financial transactions.
  • Ensure compliance with financial policies and procedures, minimizing discrepancies and errors.
  • Partner with shipboard leaders to implement best practices and drive continuous improvement in service delivery.
  • Monitor KPIs and guest feedback to identify opportunities for operational enhancements.
  • Ensure all guest-facing operations comply with HESS policies, public health standards, and safety regulations.
  • Support emergency procedures and maintain readiness for audit and inspection requirements.
Crew Services Operations
  • Oversee all administrative services for crew members, including onboarding, offboarding, travel arrangements, and immigration documentation.
  • Ensure timely and accurate processing of pre-arrival, arrival, and departure paperwork in coordination with shore-side teams and authorities.
  • Manage crew berthing modules, optimizing space allocation and maintaining accuracy in crew management systems.
  • Ensure crew lists are updated in the ERP system and reflect real-time changes.
  • Monitor Crew Office performance, staffing levels, and adherence to service standards.
  • Lead regular team meetings and training sessions to ensure alignment with policies and procedures.
  • Ensure effective use of hotel systems to maintain accurate teammate records and operational data.
  • Provide empathetic support to crew members, addressing concerns and complaints with professionalism and care.
  • Promote the onboard CRUISE program, reinforcing shared values and fostering a positive work culture.
  • Deliver service and product knowledge training to Crew Office staff to enhance the overall teammate experience.
  • Set clear expectations and role descriptions for Crew Office team members.
  • Conduct fair and objective performance appraisals and support career development through coaching and training.
  • Ensure all team members complete required training and remain current on company policies and services.
  • Ensure full compliance with HESS MS, public health standards, and safety protocols.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and assist in emergency procedures, safeguarding crew records in accordance with company policy.
  • Address audit findings promptly and ensure corrective actions are implemented effectively.

data.key_responsibilities:
The Hotel Storekeeper is responsible for efficient inventory control, storage, and distribution of all hotel consumables onboard. This role ensures accurate stock levels, proper handling of goods, and adherence to company standards and safety regulations.
  • Manage inventory control processes for all hotel supplies, including food & beverage items, housekeeping materials, and guest amenities, ensuring that stock levels are accurately recorded, tracked, and consistently aligned with operational requirements and company budget targets.
  • Oversee the receiving process for all incoming deliveries, carefully inspecting quantities and product quality against purchase orders, identifying discrepancies or damages, and coordinating with provisioning and procurement teams to resolve issues in a timely and compliant manner.
  • Ensure proper storage and organization of all inventory items, applying FIFO (First-In, First-Out) principles, maintaining clear labeling systems, and strictly adhering to hygiene, sanitation, and safety standards (including HACCP requirements) to prevent contamination or spoilage.
  • Control and execute the distribution of goods to onboard departments, ensuring that all requisitions are processed accurately, authorized appropriately, and documented within the inventory system to maintain full traceability and accountability.
  • Perform regular physical stock counts and participate in monthly inventory audits, proactively identifying variances, investigating root causes of discrepancies, and implementing corrective actions to maintain stock accuracy and prevent loss or shrinkage.
  • Monitor inventory levels and consumption trends, providing timely reporting to leadership on potential shortages, overstock risks, or unusual usage patterns, and supporting forecast planning to optimize ordering cycles and reduce waste.
  • Maintain compliance with all company policies and maritime regulations, ensuring that storage areas, handling procedures, and documentation practices meet internal audit standards as well as external inspection requirements.
  • Collaborate closely with hotel operations, galley teams, and purchasing departments, fostering effective communication to ensure that operational needs are met without disruption while maintaining cost efficiency and inventory discipline.
data.skills_knowledge_expertise:
• Minimum 3 years of professional experience in storekeeping, inventory management, or logistics operations, preferably within the hospitality, cruise, or large-scale catering industry, demonstrating the ability to manage high-volume stock in a dynamic environment.
  • Proven working knowledge of inventory management systems and digital tracking tools, with the ability to accurately input, extract, and analyze data to support operational decisions and reporting requirements.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills, with a track record of maintaining accurate records, minimizing discrepancies, and ensuring structured storage systems even under pressure.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, multicultural environment, demonstrating flexibility, adaptability, and a collaborative mindset while supporting diverse teams and operational demands onboard.
  • Good command of the English language (written and spoken), enabling clear communication with international colleagues, accurate documentation, and effective coordination across departments.
  • Solid understanding of safety, sanitation, and storage regulations, including food safety standards such as HACCP, and the ability to consistently apply these principles in daily operations.
  • Previous shipboard experience is highly preferred, particularly in a similar inventory, provisioning, or logistics role, reflecting familiarity with maritime operations and onboard life.

data.key_responsibilities:
The Hotel Storekeeper is responsible for efficient inventory control, storage, and distribution of all hotel consumables onboard. This role ensures accurate stock levels, proper handling of goods, and adherence to company standards and safety regulations.
  • Manage inventory control processes for all hotel supplies, including food & beverage items, housekeeping materials, and guest amenities, ensuring that stock levels are accurately recorded, tracked, and consistently aligned with operational requirements and company budget targets.
  • Oversee the receiving process for all incoming deliveries, carefully inspecting quantities and product quality against purchase orders, identifying discrepancies or damages, and coordinating with provisioning and procurement teams to resolve issues in a timely and compliant manner.
  • Ensure proper storage and organization of all inventory items, applying FIFO (First-In, First-Out) principles, maintaining clear labeling systems, and strictly adhering to hygiene, sanitation, and safety standards (including HACCP requirements) to prevent contamination or spoilage.
  • Control and execute the distribution of goods to onboard departments, ensuring that all requisitions are processed accurately, authorized appropriately, and documented within the inventory system to maintain full traceability and accountability.
  • Perform regular physical stock counts and participate in monthly inventory audits, proactively identifying variances, investigating root causes of discrepancies, and implementing corrective actions to maintain stock accuracy and prevent loss or shrinkage.
  • Monitor inventory levels and consumption trends, providing timely reporting to leadership on potential shortages, overstock risks, or unusual usage patterns, and supporting forecast planning to optimize ordering cycles and reduce waste.
  • Maintain compliance with all company policies and maritime regulations, ensuring that storage areas, handling procedures, and documentation practices meet internal audit standards as well as external inspection requirements.
  • Collaborate closely with hotel operations, galley teams, and purchasing departments, fostering effective communication to ensure that operational needs are met without disruption while maintaining cost efficiency and inventory discipline.
data.skills_knowledge_expertise:
• Minimum 3 years of professional experience in storekeeping, inventory management, or logistics operations, preferably within the hospitality, cruise, or large-scale catering industry, demonstrating the ability to manage high-volume stock in a dynamic environment.
  • Proven working knowledge of inventory management systems and digital tracking tools, with the ability to accurately input, extract, and analyze data to support operational decisions and reporting requirements.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills, with a track record of maintaining accurate records, minimizing discrepancies, and ensuring structured storage systems even under pressure.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, multicultural environment, demonstrating flexibility, adaptability, and a collaborative mindset while supporting diverse teams and operational demands onboard.
  • Good command of the English language (written and spoken), enabling clear communication with international colleagues, accurate documentation, and effective coordination across departments.
  • Solid understanding of safety, sanitation, and storage regulations, including food safety standards such as HACCP, and the ability to consistently apply these principles in daily operations.
  • Previous shipboard experience is highly preferred, particularly in a similar inventory, provisioning, or logistics role, reflecting familiarity with maritime operations and onboard life.

You’ll be an essential part of delivering the Princess Cruises experience, helping our crew and guests feel at their best, whether on a formal night or during everyday operations.

Join Princess Cruises and lead guest service excellence across the fleet.
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced hospitality professional for the role of Corporate Guest Services Manager.
In this high-impact role, you will travel across the fleet to support and elevate the Guest Services and Rooms Division teams, ensuring consistent, high-quality guest experiences aligned with Princess brand standards.

Guest Experience Leadership
  • Support and mentor Guest Services Directors and Rooms Division Managers to drive guest satisfaction and team engagement.
  • Oversee the full spectrum of Guest Services operations, including service delivery, issue resolution, suite experience, public area standards, laundry, and stateroom services.

Operational Excellence
  • Monitor performance using the Hotel Operations Dashboard and quality assurance tools.
  • Conduct ship visits to assess compliance, gather feedback, and identify improvement opportunities.
  • Optimize use of MedallionClass tools and digital platforms to enhance personalization and efficiency.
Team Development
  • Foster a culture of accountability, continuous learning, and performance excellence.
  • Identify and develop future leaders through coaching, training, and succession planning.
  • Communicate updates, business strategies, and expectations in a clear and motivating manner.
Financial Oversight
  • Support budget planning and monitor expenditures across Guest Services and Rooms Division functions.
  • Identify cost-efficient solutions that maintain or improve service delivery.
Safety & Compliance
  • Ensure all team members adhere to HESS, public health, and company safety standards.
  • Work with onboard leadership to proactively manage audit readiness and outbreak response.
  • Serve as a liaison with regulatory authorities and ensure professional representation at all times.

data.key_responsibilities:
As a Utility Dining Attendant, you will play an essential role in providing high-quality dining service to our guests. You will be responsible for supporting the service team and ensuring that food and beverage operations are executed seamlessly. Your professionalism, attention to detail, and ability to provide outstanding service will help make every guest’s experience a memorable one.

Service Excellence:
  • Consistently support the service team in achieving Food & Beverage targets by following all Service Excellence standards.
  • Take ownership of delivering a consistent product and service experience that meets all standards, ensuring both guest and teammate satisfaction.
  • Address any guest or teammate issues promptly and work collaboratively with others to resolve them effectively.
  • Embrace and utilize MedallionClass products, services, and applications to enhance guest experiences.
Dining Area Setup & Service:
  • Ensure the correct setup and presentation of dining areas, maintaining brand standards at all times.
  • Assist with the timely delivery of food & beverage items, clear and clean tables, and maintain the cleanliness of the dining areas.
  • Maintain stock levels of food, beverage, or hotel items, and replenish as needed to ensure seamless service.
  • Assist in the delivery of food and beverage service as directed, ensuring service standards are followed.
Guest and Teammate Interaction:
  • Be knowledgeable of onboard products, offerings, itinerary, and port information to provide guests with helpful assistance as needed.
  • Ensure all guest and teammate orders are accurately recorded and processed using the onboard POS system.
Health, Safety, and Compliance:
  • Report any Responsible Service of Alcohol (RSA) related issues promptly to the supervisor or leader on duty.
  • Perform General Emergency Procedures confidently and promptly as per company directives.
  • Follow company guidelines for handling garbage, biohazardous, and sharps waste, ensuring proper sorting and disposal.
  • Support the creation of a safe and compliant environment while committing to Operation Oceans Alive.
  • Maintain compliance with company brand and Health, Environmental, Safety, and Security (HESS) standards.
  • Keep up-to-date with public health standards, ensuring compliance and reporting any issues immediately.
Additional Responsibilities:
  • Assist with sanitation efforts as directed, especially in outbreak situations requiring increased cleanliness and hygiene.
data.skills_knowledge_expertise:
• Proven F&B Experience: At least 1 year of experience in roles such as Restaurant Waiter, F&B Runner, or similar positions in the food and beverage industry.
  • Public Health Knowledge: Basic understanding of public health and sanitation regulations and procedures.
  • Organizational Skills: Ability to organize work efficiently and meet deadlines.
  • Food & Beverage Knowledge: Working knowledge of food and beverage products, services, and general restaurant operations.
  • Communication Skills: Good command of the English language, both verbal and written.
  • Guest Service Focus: A strong foundation in guest service with the ability and willingness to deliver exceptional service to our guests.
  • Motivated & Caring: Motivated to excel in all aspects of job duties with a warm, friendly, and caring personality. A passion for surprising and delighting guests throughout their cruise experience.
  • Teamwork & Professionalism: Commitment to maintaining professional and courteous working relationships in a diverse, multicultural environment.
  • Japanese language proficiency: ranging from Basic (JLPT N5) to Fluent (JLPT N1). Candidates must be able to understand and hold conversations with Japanese guests.

data.key_responsibilities:
As an Assistant Purser, you will play a vital role in supporting either the Guest Services or Administration function onboard, depending on operational needs. This position is key to ensuring smooth guest operations, accurate documentation, and exceptional service delivery. You will supervise and support Guest Services Officers or coordinate administrative processes related to guest movement, compliance, and reporting, while upholding Princess Cruises’ standards of excellence, safety, and integrity.

Please note: Assignment to either the Guest Services or Administration function will be determined based on operational requirements and may remain fixed for the duration of the contract.

Guest Services Function
  • Supervise Guest Services Officers, ensuring they understand and adhere to all Hotel Policies & Procedures, financial controls, and service standards.
  • Provide ongoing coaching and support to help team members effectively use hotel systems and tools.
  • Ensure Guest Services Officers demonstrate commitment to the CRUISE program and Core Values in every interaction.
  • Assist the Guest Services Manager in scheduling staff to optimize coverage and maintain service standards.
  • Ensure guest complaints and hotel defects are documented accurately and escalated appropriately.
  • Support the resolution of lost luggage reports and ensure timely updates are provided to affected guests.
  • Promote ownership of guest issues among team members, ensuring follow-up and resolution are clearly communicated.
  • Assist in delivering service and product knowledge training to Guest Services Officers.
  • Help develop routines that provide team members with experience across various service roles.
  • Maintain current knowledge of public health standards and assist in coordinating onboard responses to outbreak situations.Ensure Guest Services Officers maintain accurate floats and settle shipboard accounts correctly, in line with company procedures.
  • Monitor compliance with financial controls and support the resolution of discrepancies.

Administration Function
  • Work closely with port officials to provide suitable working areas and ensure accurate handover of guest documentation.
  • Prepare, process, and transmit APIS and Landing Order files to CBP, U.S. Coast Guard, and other authorities in compliance with MSPM and HESS-MS policies.
  • Advise onboard and shore-side teams on guest and crew counts prior to sailing, including international guest details requiring translated materials.
  • Ensure data integrity and confidentiality of Personally Identifiable Information (PII) at all times.
  • Accurately prepare and deliver the non-revenue list, Fleet Cabin utilization report, and coordinate disembarkation logistics.
  • Liaise with department managers and the Crew Manager to ensure non-revenue guests meet Customs and Immigration requirements.
  • Coordinate transfers with Port Agents and ensure proper documentation for guests breaking voyage or joining at Wayports.
  • Meet with shoreside embarkation teams prior to embarkation to provide documentation guidance and reference materials.
  • Ensure missing guest information is entered into the Navigator check-in app and required documentation is collected.
  • Be present in the terminal during embarkation and disembarkation to assist ground handlers and check-in supervisors.

Asst Purser may be assigned to Night Manager role and work during night shifts, managing overnight Hotel operations to ensure excellent guest service continues at all times.

• Graduate of a recognized hotel or business school or 2-year experience as Front Desk Supervisor or Assistant Manager.
  • Cruise ship experience is strongly preferred.
  • Proficiency in the use of Front Desk computer-based programs and excellent knowledge of M/S Office.
  • Specific experience and knowledge in all aspects of immigration and clearance requirements within the US and worldwide.
  • Excellent command of the English language, both verbal and written.
  • Knowledge of additional languages is strongly preferred.
  • Fantastic attitude and a natural love and ability for dealing with complex issues in a guest facing environment.
  • Understanding of the foundation of guest service; ability and willingness to deliver outstanding service to our guests. 
  • Motivation to excel in all aspects of job duties and responsibilities. 
  • Personable communicator with outstanding social skills and a warm, friendly, and caring personality. 
  • Ability to continuously surprise and delight guests throughout their cruise experience. 
  • Commitment to establish and maintain courteous and professional working relationships in a diverse cultural environment.

As an Assistant Purser, you will play a vital role in supporting either the Guest Services or Administration function onboard, depending on operational needs. This position is key to ensuring smooth guest operations, accurate documentation, and exceptional service delivery. You will supervise and support Guest Services Officers or coordinate administrative processes related to guest movement, compliance, and reporting, while upholding Princess Cruises’ standards of excellence, safety, and integrity.

Please note: Assignment to either the Guest Services or Administration function will be determined based on operational requirements and may remain fixed for the duration of the contract.

Guest Services Function
  • Supervise Guest Services Officers, ensuring they understand and adhere to all Hotel Policies & Procedures, financial controls, and service standards.
  • Provide ongoing coaching and support to help team members effectively use hotel systems and tools.
  • Ensure Guest Services Officers demonstrate commitment to the CRUISE program and Core Values in every interaction.
  • Assist the Guest Services Manager in scheduling staff to optimize coverage and maintain service standards.
  • Ensure guest complaints and hotel defects are documented accurately and escalated appropriately.
  • Support the resolution of lost luggage reports and ensure timely updates are provided to affected guests.
  • Promote ownership of guest issues among team members, ensuring follow-up and resolution are clearly communicated.
  • Assist in delivering service and product knowledge training to Guest Services Officers.
  • Help develop routines that provide team members with experience across various service roles.
  • Maintain current knowledge of public health standards and assist in coordinating onboard responses to outbreak situations.Ensure Guest Services Officers maintain accurate floats and settle shipboard accounts correctly, in line with company procedures.
  • Monitor compliance with financial controls and support the resolution of discrepancies.

Administration Function
  • Work closely with port officials to provide suitable working areas and ensure accurate handover of guest documentation.
  • Prepare, process, and transmit APIS and Landing Order files to CBP, U.S. Coast Guard, and other authorities in compliance with MSPM and HESS-MS policies.
  • Advise onboard and shore-side teams on guest and crew counts prior to sailing, including international guest details requiring translated materials.
  • Ensure data integrity and confidentiality of Personally Identifiable Information (PII) at all times.
  • Accurately prepare and deliver the non-revenue list, Fleet Cabin utilization report, and coordinate disembarkation logistics.
  • Liaise with department managers and the Crew Manager to ensure non-revenue guests meet Customs and Immigration requirements.
  • Coordinate transfers with Port Agents and ensure proper documentation for guests breaking voyage or joining at Wayports.
  • Meet with shoreside embarkation teams prior to embarkation to provide documentation guidance and reference materials.
  • Ensure missing guest information is entered into the Navigator check-in app and required documentation is collected.
  • Be present in the terminal during embarkation and disembarkation to assist ground handlers and check-in supervisors.

Asst Purser may be assigned to Night Manager role and work during night shifts, managing overnight Hotel operations to ensure excellent guest service continues at all times.

  • Execute all events and production elements in assigned lounges, prioritizing safety at all times.

  • Prepare accurate handover notes to ensure seamless transitions between shifts.

  • Learn and apply basic automation operations, including Fire Curtain, Safety E-Stop, screens, and curtains.

• The Activity Staff is responsible for creating lasting memories by consistently delivering a guest-centric product experience that aligns with brand standards and health and sanitization protocols. They create positive connections, emcee key activity and entertainment programming, and support a guest and teammate-centric culture that increases Net Promoter, profitability, Service Excellence, and drives a safe and healthy environment in accordance with HESS protocols.
  • As a natural performer, they create, host, train, promote, emcee, and assist all activities and events, creating an engaging and entertaining experience for guests. They embrace MedallionClass products, services, and applications to identify guests and deliver exceptional, personalized service. They are accountable for consistent product delivery and apply the Service Excellence philosophy.
  • They collaborate with onboard teammates to provide reliable information and updates to deliver an outstanding guest experience. They provide a positive first impression to guests through a warm, welcoming greeting, maintain the company's standard, and comply with fleet safety regulations in accordance with HESS protocols.
  • They own their experience area and support the development, implementation, and execution of initiatives in alignment with the Entertainment leadership team. They anticipate and take ownership of guest needs and requests, demonstrate responsibility, authority, and accountability in all performance areas, and actively learn and answer questions on product, policy, demographic, itinerary, and port information.
  • They arrive at events at least 15 minutes early to ensure efficient setup and engage with guests, and prioritize performance standards set out by the Cruise Staff Tier Program. They responsibly use consumable items and maintain assigned equipment clean and in good condition.
data.skills_knowledge_expertise:
• Candidates for the role of Activity Staff must demonstrate an understanding of the fundamental principles of guest experience and hospitality operations. They must also exhibit a commitment to providing exemplary guest service and a willingness to support others in the delivery of the same.  
  • Those who are successful in their candidacy must demonstrate a comprehensive knowledge and enthusiasm for the implementation of an engaging and high-quality activity program, with a commitment to providing experiences for individuals of all ages and abilities. Furthermore, they must exhibit a clear understanding of the importance of offering a diverse range of activities that cater to the varying interests and abilities of participants.  
  • The candidate must possess a stage style that is confident yet charming, charismatic and energetic. The delivery must be controlled, natural and easy to watch, yet engaging, humorous and endearing.

This role combines technical expertise in wine service, inventory management, and team leadership with a passion for delivering personalized, memorable moments at sea. 

  • Align wine service standards with voyage service score targets in partnership with the Director of Restaurant Operations and the Beverage Manager.

  • Take an active lead in executing signature events such as the Frescobaldi Dinner and Sanctuary Class wine programs on Sphere Class vessels.
  • Collaborate with Hotel Inventory Manager, Provision Master, and Beverage Manager to manage wine inventory strategically.
  • Monitor daily wine sales performance and provide detailed reporting to leadership.
  • Ensure accurate inventory counts, investigate discrepancies, and maintain par levels across all service areas.
  • Develop depletion plans for aged or slow-moving wines while maintaining cost efficiency.
  • Oversee timely and accurate submission of all required reports to the Director of Restaurant Operations and Corporate Office.
  • Ensure compliance with company protocols for wine service, stock control, and POS system usage.

As a Lounge Technician with Princess Cruises, you will play a key role in delivering world-class entertainment experiences for our guests. This position requires technical expertise, attention to detail, and a commitment to safety while supporting events and productions across multiple venues onboard.
  • Execute all events and production elements in assigned lounges, prioritizing safety at all times.
  • Communicate professionally with Supervisors, Music Managers, Company Managers, Vocal Captains, and Guest Entertainers.
  • Provide clear and timely updates to the Senior Production Manager regarding technical assistance needs.
  • Prepare accurate handover notes to ensure seamless transitions between shifts.
  • Maintain the integrity of Princess-produced entertainment, including Guest Entertainer Shows, Cruise Staff activities, and specialty events.
  • Operate audio systems proficiently, including digital consoles and associated equipment, while continuously developing technical skills.
  • Set up band equipment (microphones, amplifiers, Aviom systems, music stands, cables) and ensure readiness for performances.
  • Operate lighting systems, including MA Lighting, LED fixtures, video playback, and processing equipment.
  • Learn and apply basic automation operations, including Fire Curtain, Safety E-Stop, screens, and curtains.
  • Support guest entertainer requirements for lighting, audio, A/V setups, and stage cues.
  • Assist with equipment maintenance, repairs, and inventory reporting in collaboration with the technical team.
  • Provide training and coaching to stage staff, promoting teamwork and adherence to company standards.
  • Encourage creativity and adaptability in event execution while maintaining operational excellence.
data.skills_knowledge_expertise:
• Advanced Technical Proficiency: Demonstrated knowledge of audio, lighting, and A/V systems, including full band setups, signal flow, and equipment configuration. Ability to operate, maintain, and troubleshoot professional-grade systems used in live entertainment environments.
  • Live Production Experience: Prior experience in live event production, technical theater operations, or similar performance‑driven environments is strongly preferred. Familiarity with backstage workflows, cueing, and event‑ready technical preparation is an advantage.
  • Troubleshooting & Problem-Solving: Strong diagnostic skills with the ability to respond quickly and effectively to technical issues in a high‑pressure, time‑sensitive setting.
  • Collaborative Work Style: Proven capacity to work as part of a multidisciplinary team, supporting performers, stage staff, and entertainment leadership while maintaining smooth show operations in a dynamic, fast‑paced lounge environment.
  • Communication & Organization: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey technical information clearly. Strong organizational abilities for equipment management, show preparation, and documentation.
  • English Fluency: Proficient command of the English language, both spoken and written, ensuring clear communication with team members, performers, and guests.
  • Safety & Compliance: A strong commitment to maintaining a safe working environment by adhering to all company policies, safety procedures, and compliance standards. Proactive in identifying potential hazards and ensuring safe equipment operation.

  • The successful candidate will have experience and knowledge of USPH, the beverage industry, and will have a specialization in wines, cocktails, spirits and all other beverage-related products. They will also have experience in the service execution of all of the above. 
  • They will have excellent management and bartending skills, and will be able to develop and motivate and lead a large team. 
  • They will also be able to work under pressure and make decisions which positively impact the overall guest experience.
  • Finally, the successful candidate will have a good command of the English and Japanese language, both verbal and written.

data.key_responsibilities:
As an Assistant Purser, you will play a vital role in supporting either the Guest Services or Administration function onboard, depending on operational needs. This position is key to ensuring smooth guest operations, accurate documentation, and exceptional service delivery. You will supervise and support Guest Services Officers or coordinate administrative processes related to guest movement, compliance, and reporting, while upholding Princess Cruises’ standards of excellence, safety, and integrity.

Please note: Assignment to either the Guest Services or Administration function will be determined based on operational requirements and may remain fixed for the duration of the contract.

Guest Services Function
  • Supervise Guest Services Officers, ensuring they understand and adhere to all Hotel Policies & Procedures, financial controls, and service standards.
  • Provide ongoing coaching and support to help team members effectively use hotel systems and tools.
  • Ensure Guest Services Officers demonstrate commitment to the CRUISE program and Core Values in every interaction.
  • Assist the Guest Services Manager in scheduling staff to optimize coverage and maintain service standards.
  • Ensure guest complaints and hotel defects are documented accurately and escalated appropriately.
  • Support the resolution of lost luggage reports and ensure timely updates are provided to affected guests.
  • Promote ownership of guest issues among team members, ensuring follow-up and resolution are clearly communicated.
  • Assist in delivering service and product knowledge training to Guest Services Officers.
  • Help develop routines that provide team members with experience across various service roles.
  • Maintain current knowledge of public health standards and assist in coordinating onboard responses to outbreak situations.Ensure Guest Services Officers maintain accurate floats and settle shipboard accounts correctly, in line with company procedures.
  • Monitor compliance with financial controls and support the resolution of discrepancies.

Administration Function
  • Work closely with port officials to provide suitable working areas and ensure accurate handover of guest documentation.
  • Prepare, process, and transmit APIS and Landing Order files to CBP, U.S. Coast Guard, and other authorities in compliance with MSPM and HESS-MS policies.
  • Advise onboard and shore-side teams on guest and crew counts prior to sailing, including international guest details requiring translated materials.
  • Ensure data integrity and confidentiality of Personally Identifiable Information (PII) at all times.
  • Accurately prepare and deliver the non-revenue list, Fleet Cabin utilization report, and coordinate disembarkation logistics.
  • Liaise with department managers and the Crew Manager to ensure non-revenue guests meet Customs and Immigration requirements.
  • Coordinate transfers with Port Agents and ensure proper documentation for guests breaking voyage or joining at Wayports.
  • Meet with shoreside embarkation teams prior to embarkation to provide documentation guidance and reference materials.
  • Ensure missing guest information is entered into the Navigator check-in app and required documentation is collected.
  • Be present in the terminal during embarkation and disembarkation to assist ground handlers and check-in supervisors.

Asst Purser may be assigned to Night Manager role and work during night shifts, managing overnight Hotel operations to ensure excellent guest service continues at all times.
